solstice-onboarding: Hey team — completed SSO/OIDC onboarding but no API key is visible in our console and our app calls are getting 403s. Need help asap.

maya (Support): Hi! Sorry for the hassle. Can you paste your org and project IDs and the console URL? Also the exact error from the API when you try a request.

solstice-onboarding: Org: solstice-co (org_8871), Project: prod-app (proj_3321). Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/8871/projects/3321/keys — shows "No API keys".

When our app does:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
```
we get:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"permission_denied","code":"project_not_found","message":"request mapped to project 9999 which is not visible to your org"}
```

maya (Support): Thanks. I'm looking at the provisioning events now — I see a claim event for your onboarding. It looks like the claim was applied but mapped to project id 9999 (internal-temp) instead of proj_3321. @provisioner-bot can you paste the claim log?

provisioner-bot: LOG SNIPPET 2026-03-17T10:25:07Z
```
claim_id=claim-76234 event=CLAIM_APPLIED mapped_project=9999 assigned_key_id=key_abc123 status=ACTIVE note="applied via claim filter: email_verified"
```

eli (Infra): Hmm. That note is interesting — the mapper used an `email_verified` claim filter. If the customer's OIDC provider doesn't send that claim, our mapper apparently falls back to an internal project (9999). Do you know which IdP you use?

solstice-onboarding: We're on Okta, federating with Google for login. I don't think Google sets `email_verified` by default in our Okta app.

eli (Infra): That fits. There's a mapper edge-case where a missing claim triggers the fallback route. Workaround: I can manually rebind the claim to your project. Run:
```
inv provisioner rebind --claim claim-76234 --target-project proj_3321
```
That will reassign `key_abc123` to your project and surface it in the console.

jorge (Eng): I'll kick the rebind now and watch the job.

jorge (Eng): Rebind output:
```
Starting rebind for claim-76234...
Found key key_abc123 -> current_project=9999
Assigning key key_abc123 -> target_project=proj_3321
Update complete. status=SUCCESS
```
:tada:

maya (Support): Can you verify the console and API now?

solstice-onboarding: Tested — keys show up in console and `curl` to /v1/models now returns 200 and model list. Everything looks back to normal. Thank you!! :heart:

eli (Infra): Logged ENG-1549 for the claim-mapper fallback behaviour: default mapping must not route to an internal holding project when a claim is missing. We'll patch the mapper and run a backfill for recent onboard events. Also recommend customers ensure `email_verified` or the equivalent is mapped in Okta. I'll add a KB note.

jorge (Eng): Patch plan: small fix -> canary -> prod rollout within 48h. Backfill script queued to re-evaluate claims for last 72h and reassign any keys stuck on 9999.

maya (Support): I'll follow up with SolsticeCo and confirm communications about the patch and the workaround. Closing loop when backfill completes. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
